resources.string: On. You get messages and pass them on for others. Don’t swipe Ping Up away in the app switcher, and leave Bluetooth on, in Airplane Mode too: otherwise the iPhone won’t start it again by itself.
On an iPhone, Ping Up keeps working locked in your pocket. To keep it so, don’t swipe it away in the app switcher, and leave Bluetooth on, in Airplane Mode too.
On an iPhone, the question comes on time even with the app in the background. The alert to your friends, though, leaves only while Ping Up is awake: open, or near other phones with Ping Up.
Bluetooth is off. Turn it on in Control Center or in Settings.
Turn on sounds and Time Sensitive Notifications for Ping Up, so alarms get through Focus. With the phone on silent, they only vibrate.
The iPhone’s own reports on the app (crashes, energy use) go too, with nothing about you.
